messages:
Maya: Heads-up — running an attendance pulse for the early-access cohort this week. We have 7 accounts that haven't joined enablement calls yet, and 3 showing low usage. Can folks help triage?
Oliver: I can take the finance vertical ones (Arclight, Novus). Dropping a calendar slot for Arclight now.
Tess: I'll ping product for the missing integration docs (they pushed a late change to the webhook). linking the doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/webhooks/integrations-v2 :slightly_smiling_face:
Ravi: Which 3 are low-usage? I want to check whether it's config or prompts.
Maya: Low usage: SableTech, Meridian Health, HelixOps. Enrollment no-shows: Arclight, Nimbus, Cinder, Atlas, Zephyr, Orion, Marlowe.
Sam: quick checklist before outreach: 1) seat assigned 2) API key present 3) onboarding template sent 4) prod whitelisting done. I can run a CSV pull and share.
Maya: yes please — Sam can you paste the CSV subset here once ready?
Sam: done, small snippet below:
```
account,owner,last_active,seat_count,onboarding_sent
Arclight,oliver,2026-02-12,3,true
Nimbus,maya,2026-02-01,2,false
Cinder,tess,2026-01-28,1,true
SableTech,ravi,2026-02-15,5,true
Meridian Health,amy,2026-01-10,4,true
HelixOps,jon,2026-01-04,2,true
```
Maya: Thanks. Nimbus is an easy re-engage (onboarding_sent false) — @Oliver can you take that follow-up?
Oliver: On it. Will call their PM this afternoon and confirm a slot.
Tess: For Cinder, the integration change means they need a short patch from their infra team. I'll loop in product engineering and send a step-by-step.
Ravi: For SableTech and HelixOps I'll run a prompt/usage audit and flag any model mismatch. Might be quantization fallback causing weird outputs.
Maya: FYI — flagged 2 accounts (Meridian Health, HelixOps) as potential renewal risk if we don't see activity in next 21 days. Adding the risk tag in Gainsight.
Sam: Created outreach templates and a pre-filled survey link for feedback capture: https://redwood.surveys/ea-onboard-pulse — use the short one (3 q's).
Maya: Good. Can folks add a quick note to the CS playbook after outreach with outcome? I want a single source-of-truth before EOM review.
eng-bot: Calendar invite created: "Arclight — EA onboarding follow-up" (Mar 3, 2026 3:00 PM PT) — Invites: Oliver, Arclight PM
Oliver: Update after call: Nimbus confirmed, onboarding slot scheduled for next Tuesday. Leaving a note in Gainsight. :thumbsup:
Tess: Cinder infra acknowledged, ETA for patch Wed EOD. I'll schedule a verification call when done.
Ravi: Audit finds SableTech prompts are batching too big — adding recommended changes and a suggestion to enable prefix caching.
Maya: Great work — I'll consolidate these into the weekly pulse doc and send a short summary to the renewal ops team. Anyone who can't finish their action by EOD Friday, please ping me. :eyes:
